elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Items (v) and (vi) expressly apply following or within a stated period of “such termination or expiration.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Item (v) requires Kubient, at Customer’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (v) specifies assistance “for up to six (6) months following such termination or expiration.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Item (v) expressly states that assistance will be provided “at Kubient’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) requires Kubient to return to Customer “all Content, Requests and other Customer data” in Kubient’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) requires return within thirty days of termination or expiration.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) states that Kubient will “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) requires Kubient to certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (v) creates a transition-assistance obligation following termination or expiration, exercisable at Customer’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least the 90-day fallback period.
elements.evidence: The permitted assistance period is up to six months, which encompasses the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data to Customer following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) requires Kubient to return all specified Customer data to Customer following termination or expiration.

elements.element: The Customer Data export occurs within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (vi) expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline after termination or expiration.

result.reason: The operative additions satisfy every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfy the fallback. They cover both termination and expiration, provide up to six months of requested transition assistance at then-current rates, require return of all Customer data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and require subsequent deletion and written certification. The changes are confined to transition and data-exit obligations and do not displace unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is reduced by structural issues: the parent clause is captioned only for termination even though the new subclauses also address expiration, the pre-existing numbering and punctuation are awkward, and the relationship between the general return-or-destroy option in item (iv) and the mandatory data-return sequence in item (vi) could be stated more cleanly.
